{{Top|leg}}
The '''Clock Spires of Harai Nova''' were an architectural treasure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in the years leading up to [[19,000 BBY]]. The Spires became submerged [[Water/Legends|underwater]] when the surface ice melted and covered the planetary surface.
